mistakes.text: Nobody likes rushing on a day trip like this.
mistakes.normalized: nobody likes rushing on a day trip like this
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Rushing“ znamená, že sa ponáhľa sám; treba Passive: „being rushed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Rushing“ znamená, že spěchá sám; je potřeba Passive: „being rushed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Rushing” means hurrying yourself; you need the Passive: “being rushed”.
